pr_semantic_analysis.change_summary: The reconciler now considers a form already upgraded to stateful only when its existing hook has a successor hook. The accompanying regression test exercises two closely spaced submissions while the first action is still pending and expects both actions to run without an exception. The test is currently committed as a focused `it.only` test.

behavior_changes.description: When the same form is submitted twice in rapid succession while its asynchronous action is still pending, the intended behavior is now for both submissions to invoke the action without throwing. Internally, a form with only one existing hook is no longer treated as fully upgraded to stateful form handling.
evidence: The stateful-form fast path now requires both an existing hook and a non-null next hook.
The regression test issues two `requestSubmit()` calls separated by a short delay and verifies that the action runs twice.
